metadata.summary: Jutin attempted to order an Avocado BLT Sandwich with a French Toast Bagel, but the bagel option was not available for that specific sandwich.

I don't see Avocado Beer LT Sandwich on our menu. However, we do have some great options like the Avocado BLT Sandwich or our Avocado Veg Out. Which of these sounds good to you?
